models._description: History for Loyalty cards and Ewallets

behavioral_notes.observation: program_type drives the whole record: it is one of 8 values (coupons, gift_card, loyalty, promotion, ewallet, promo_code, buy_x_get_y, next_order_coupons). On change, _compute_from_program_type writes the type's default values from _program_type_default_values() into rule_ids/reward_ids/communication_plan_ids (clearing then recreating them). is_payment_program is True for gift_card/ewallet; is_nominative for loyalty/ewallet 'future' and any 'both'. program.write() also propagates 'active' to child rules, rewards and their discount_line_product_id. None of this branching is visible in metadata.

A rule defines WHEN points accrue and at what rate but stores no order data. reward_point_mode is per order / per money spent / per unit paid; mode is auto vs with_code (a unique promo code, enforced by _constrains_code against both other rules and loyalty.card codes). minimum_qty/minimum_amount(+tax_mode) are thresholds, and _get_valid_product_domain() builds a product.product domain from product_ids/category/tag/product_domain to decide which lines qualify. The actual matching of a rule against a cart/order is performed by the consuming module (sale/pos/website_sale), not here.

reward_type is product (free product) or discount (percent / per_order / per_point, applicable to order/cheapest/specific). On create(), every reward calls _create_missing_discount_line_products(), which CREATES a dedicated product.product (type=service, sale_ok=False, lst_price=0) used as the order line that carries the discount/free product for invoicing & reporting. write() keeps that product's name synced to the reward description and archives/unarchives it with the reward. _compute_is_global_discount flags order-wide percent/per_order discounts. A reward creating a backing product record is invisible in field metadata.

loyalty.card is the issued coupon/loyalty card/gift card/eWallet holding a points balance (tracking=True) reserved for partner_id when nominative. create() fires _send_creation_communication() (the 'At Creation' loyalty.mail template); write() snapshots points before/after and fires _send_points_reach_communication() to send the 'When Reaching' milestone email (only on increases, highest milestone passed). Balance edits via the loyalty.card.update.balance wizard write loyalty.history rows (issued/used). The order-driven debit/credit of points on confirmation lives in the consumer modules (sale/pos), so the card here is a passive balance + audit trail.

5 JS files, 2 XML templates, 2 OWL components (LoyaltyActionHelper, PortalLoyaltyCardDialog); 4 registry registrations (1 field widget loyalty_one2many, 1 public.interaction loyalty.loyalty_card, 2 list views); 0 patches; asset bundles web.assets_backend (5), web.assets_web_dark (1), web.assets_frontend (2). The portal card dialog backs the /my/loyalty_card routes.

information_flows: side-effect: loyalty.reward.create -> creates a backing product.product (service) per reward
side-effect: loyalty.card.create/write -> sends loyalty.mail (creation + points-reach milestone) via mail.template
side-effect: balance edits/coupon generation -> loyalty.history (issued/used) rows
consumed-by: sale / point_of_sale / website_sale match rules, debit/credit card points, and place reward order lines (not in this module)

capabilities: Define Loyalty & Promotion Programs (coupons, promos, loyalty, gift card, eWallet, buy X get Y, next-order coupons)
Configure Earning Rules (point accrual, eligibility, promo codes)
Configure Rewards (discounts, free products, payment programs)
Issue & Manage Coupons / Cards (points balance, expiry, history)
Customer Communication on Loyalty Events (creation, milestones)
value_streams: Promotion-to-Redemption: define program -> set rules & rewards -> issue card/coupon -> accrue points on qualifying order -> redeem reward / pay with wallet
(realized end-to-end only in concert with sale/pos/website_sale that apply the rules to orders)
products: product.product (discount_line_product_id / reward backing product, auto-created service product per reward)
policies: 5 record rules: multi-company scoping on programs/rules/rewards/cards
unique promo code across rules and cards (_constrains_code)
validity-window, max-usage and positive-points/discount SQL + Python constraints
no expiration allowed on loyalty-type cards
stakeholders: Consuming channels: Sales, Point of Sale, eCommerce (website_sale)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: loyalty is a cross-cutting pricing/promotions & rewards engine, not a primary sell activity itself. It defines programs, accrual rules and rewards but stores no orders and confirms no transactions; the primary value-chain modules (sale, point_of_sale, website_sale) consume its rules to discount carts, debit/credit point balances and place reward lines. It creates customer value only through those host sell activities, so it is a Porter support activity (firm infrastructure for marketing/sales), classified support/support. Its subject matter is pricing & promotions, so within APQC it maps to 3.0 Market and Sell (3.2 Develop pricing strategy / manage promotions) rather than 3.5 order management.

standard_capabilities: 8 program types out-of-box: coupons, promotions, promo/discount code, buy X get Y, next-order coupons, loyalty cards, gift cards, eWallets
rule-based point accrual (per order / per money / per unit) with product & amount/qty eligibility
discount (percent / fixed / per-point, order/cheapest/specific) and free-product rewards, with auto-created discount products
nominative cards with points history, expiry and balance-adjustment wizard
coupon generation wizard (anonymous or per customer/tag) and program communication plans (creation + milestone emails)
customer portal view of loyalty card and point history
typical_fits: percentage / fixed promotions auto-applied or via promo code
gift cards and eWallets as payment programs
points-based loyalty with reward catalog and milestone mails
common_gaps: channel wiring: loyalty alone does nothing until sale / point_of_sale / website_sale is installed to apply it
bespoke earning/redemption math beyond the built-in point modes
tiered membership levels / status tiers (not modeled natively)
external loyalty-platform or CRM-points synchronization (no outbound integration here)

open_questions: Exact rule-matching and point debit/credit algorithm lives in the consuming modules (sale/pos/website_sale) — loyalty itself does not apply programs to orders.
How _compute_from_program_type's clear-then-recreate of rule_ids/reward_ids interacts with the reward-required constraint on rapid program_type changes (the loyalty_skip_reward_check guard).
Lifecycle of the auto-created discount_line_product_id products (cleanup, reuse, reporting) over a reward's life.
Whether eWallet/gift-card balances ever expire vs. only loyalty cards being barred from expiration.
